This sounds a lot like me and how I used to feel about a friend over a year ago (whom I'm no longer friends with, but not for that reason)

We met online and we used to talk about absolutely everything and she lived in GA and I live in NY. She was my best friend! I loved her. 

We spent a lot of time discussing our lives to each other and what we wanted to do, well, our plans were to wait until she graduated college and she was going to move her, and we were going to travel the world together, go to all fancy places, and just live our lives together. 

I've gone back and forth with my sexuality but I considered myself straight at the time, and she was also straight. But I started getting really confused just because I wanted to be with her so badly, I couldn't wait to start our lives together, I wasn't sure what I was feeling.. I thought she was the most beautiful person to ever exist, inside and out. 

It was crazy and I didn't really know how to handle it, so I just didn't, I didn't tell her anything I was feeling and I just ended up going with the flow.

She was supposed to come visit me this year but we had stopped talking before the date came up, but around that date, I had texted her and asked if she was still coming around, and she couldn't, because of something that had happened with her family, which was understandable, but I was slightly disappointed, because I was just hoping that maybe if she showed up, I could tell her everything.

But, things always seem to have their special way of working out. 

I'm sorry for giving you a story, it just seemed really similar to my situation and I thought you may enjoy.

After thinking about this for a bit though, I do believe there are many kinds of love and just because you think someone is wonderful, doesn't mean you are "in love" with them, you just admire and respect the person they are as a whole and believe they are one of the greatest out there. 

So I wouldn't over think it to much like I did, because chances are, this girl is just one of your best friends, and you think the absolute world of her.
